title: Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects
abstract: arXiv:2610.01378v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. translated_title: 行为归因之前的生成溯源：审计合成语音研究对象
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.01378v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：将模型行为归因于合成训练数据，需要在估计某个训练样本导致了什么之前，先知道该样本是由什么生成的。而波形-标签对并不保留这种知识。我们提出一种生成溯源基底，使合成研究对象绑定源规范、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、审查谱系以及不可变的清单标识。生产者与选择机制决定证据意义；存储位置和变量名则不起作用。我们在一个私密的日本护理交接流程中对该基底进行了审计。一个包含113个资产的审查群体涵盖六个场景族的1.552小时合成语音；所有条目均关联音频、转录文本、候选笔记和事实清单，但人工证据是选择性的且因来源而异。两个仅含忠实样本的清单在场景-种子上互不相交且以不可变方式版本化，而精确的上游归因……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心创新是提出一种“生成溯源基底”，将合成语音研究对象的源规范、生成内容、审查谱系与不可变清单标识绑定在一起，强调在将模型行为归因于训练数据之前必须先审计每个训练样本的生成来源，并在真实的日语护理交接语音管线中验证了这一方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generation-provenance substrate that binds source specifications, generated content, review lineage, and immutable manifest identities to synthetic speech research objects, enabling auditing of training data origins before attributing model behavior to them, validated in a real Japanese care-handoff speech pipeline.
